records.query: Apple 最近有什麼跟 Siri 有關的法律訴訟或和解消息？
records.answer:
Apple 最近因「增強版 Siri」功能未實際推出而與消費者達成一項最高可支付每部 iPhone $95、總額約 $2.5 億美元的和解協議【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  

- 這項和解金額上限為 **2.5 億美元（$250 million）**，若法院批准，將成為 Apple 歷史上規模最大的和解之一【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 和解對象為在 **2024 年 6 月 10 日至 2025 年 3 月 29 日** 期間購買 iPhone 16、iPhone 15 Pro 或 iPhone 15 Pro Max 的消費者，約 **0.37 億（37 million）** 部手機的持有者符合資格【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 每位符合資格的消費者初始可獲 **$25**，最終金額視申請情況而定，最高不超過 **$95**【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- Apple 表示此和解是為了「專注於我們最擅長的事——為使用者提供最創新的產品與服務」【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  

以上即為與 Siri 相關的最新法律和解消息。

iPhone owners could receive up to $95 under a proposed $250 million settlement resolving claims that Apple misled customers about Siri's artificial intelligence features, according to a recent court filing. The class-action lawsuit, filed in federal court in the Northern District of California on behalf of U.S. consumers, claims that Apple deceived customers by marketing "Enhanced Siri features" that did not yet exist, leading them to buy iPhones based on false advertising. The plaintiffs are seeking a $250 million settlement payment, according to a recent court filing. If approved by a judge, it could rank among the largest settlements involving Apple. "Apple has reached a settlement to resolve claims related to the availability of two additional features," an Apple spokesperson said in an email to CBS News. Clarkson Law Firm, a public interest law firm that filed the original lawsuit against Apple, said in a statement on Wednesday that the settlement would provide "timely relief to tens of millions of consumers nationwide."
Here's what to know about the recent settlement. Am I eligible? The settlement covers people who purchased an iPhone 16 model, iPhone 15 Pro or iPhone 15 Pro Max between June 10, 2024, and March 29, 2025. records.query: Apple 在最近的 WWDC 上關於 Siri 有什麼新消息？
records.answer:
Apple 在本次 WWDC 正式公布了全新 AI 版 Siri（稱為 **Siri AI**），將於今年秋季以 beta 形式在美國英語市場先行上線，並且採用了 Google 的 Gemini 系列模型來提供智慧運算能力【Reference 1: AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。

- Siri AI 能夠「從你的應用程式中抽取上下文」，讓使用者只要說出「我妹妹推薦的播客是什麼」之類的指令，就能直接呈現內容，而不必自行開啟其他 App 或服務【Reference 1: AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 這項功能是透過 Apple Intelligence 與 Google Gemini（包括 Gemini Flash‑Lite、Gemini Flash、Gemini Pro 以及 Gemini Image）結合實現，且 Apple 強調不使用 Google 提供給消費者的模型或基礎設施【Reference 1: AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 除了語音助理本身，Apple 也宣布 Siri AI 相關的 **Siri App**，讓使用者可以在同一介面管理所有對話，並持續強調安全與隱私的設計取向【Reference 4: AAPL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 目前 Siri AI 仍處於 beta 階段，預計在秋季先在美國以英語推出，屆時仍需觀察最終表現【Reference 4: AAPL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 同時，Apple 在 WWDC 也提到 iPhone 的銷售在過去四個季度增長了 **16%**，顯示產品需求強勁，為 AI 功能的推廣提供了用戶基礎【Reference 5: AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0】。  

總結來說，Apple 在 WWDC 上的 Siri 新消息包括：推出以 Google Gemini 為底層的 AI 助理 Siri AI、以 beta 形式於今年秋季先行上線、整合 Apple Intelligence、提供跨 App 上下文感知與隱私保護，並伴隨 iPhone 銷售持續成長的正向市場環境。

After two years of delays, Apple's (
AAPL
) reinvented Siri, Siri AI,

. The company unveiled the AI-powered version of its assistant at its Worldwide Developers Conference in Cupertino, Calif., on Monday, saying it will launch, albeit as a beta, later this year. The update is designed to transform Siri from a glorified kitchen timer to a
digital helper for the AI age

Apple said Siri AI will be able to pull context from your apps, allowing you to, say, ask it the name of a podcast your sister recommended via text and have it presented to you without opening any separate apps or services. The idea is for Siri AI to recognize what you want, when you want it, and surface it, whether it's content on your device or from the web. It's more or less what Apple promised when it showed off its AI-enhanced Siri and Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2024. And in early demos, Siri AI, which rides on Apple Intelligence, appears to deliver on Apple's initial vision for its reimagined Siri. And it's thanks, at least in part, to Google (
GOOG

GOOGL
). Siri gets Google brains
In January, Apple and Google signed an agreement for Apple to use the search giant's Gemini models to power its improved Siri. That gave Apple the high-powered AI models it needed to move Siri AI forward, after its own models fell short,
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman previously reported
. During a question and answer session following Apple's WWDC keynote, senior vice president of software engineering Craig Federighi explained how Apple uses Google's models to give Siri AI its smarts. The software chief was sure to point out that Siri AI isn't just a rebranded version of Google's own Gemini assistant. Federighi explained how the Gemini assistant uses Google's Gemini models, including Gemini Flash-Lite, Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, and its Gemini Image models. When it comes to grounding those models in world knowledge, he said, Gemini takes advantage of Google Search. Apple, Federighi said, uses none of those things. "We use none of the models that Google deploys to their customers, nor do we use the infrastructure and means by which they employ models to their customers," he explained.

records.query: NVIDIA 最近跟 IREN 之間有什麼合作的新聞？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 最近與 IREN 簽署了多項價值數十億美元的 AI 雲端合作協議，包含一份為期五年的 **34 億美元（$3.4 billion） AI Cloud 合約**，以及一筆 **21 億美元（$2.1 billion） 投資承諾**，此投資會隨著 NVIDIA GPU 基礎設施在 IREN 站點的部署而逐步解鎖【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  

- IREN 取得了 **5 GW** 的 NVIDIA 戰略合作權，允許 NVIDIA 在 IREN 全球資料中心部署與 NVIDIA HGX 相容的 AI 基礎設施，並可在部署 600,000 顆 GPU 後完全獲得投資權利【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  
- 2026 年 IREN 計畫建置 **480 MW** AI Cloud 容量，配備 **150,000 顆 GPU**，目標在 2026 年底達成 **37 億美元（$3.7 billion） ARR**（年度經常性收入）【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 同時，IREN 在 2027 年將擴大至 **1,210 MW**，其中 **730 MW** 正在建設中，主要集中於 Childress（約 450 MW）與 Sweetwater（約 280 MW）【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 這項合作還包括 NVIDIA 可於五年內以每股 **$70** 的價格購買最多 **0.3 億（30 million）** 普通股的權利，若全部行使，最高可帶來 **21 億美元（$2.1 billion）** 的潛在投資金額【NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 合約中約 **7 億美元（$700 million）** 的 ARR 直接與 NVIDIA 的 34 億美元（$3.4 billion） 合約掛鉤，支援在 Childress 60 MW 空冷容量上部署 Blackwell GPU【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  

總結來說，NVIDIA 與 IREN 的最新合作聚焦於 AI 雲端基礎設施的大規模擴張，透過巨額合約與投資承諾，將 IREN 的電力與資料中心資源轉化為可供 NVIDIA GPU 部署的「計算時間」，以滿足快速增長的 AI 需求【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。

China market for Nvidia AI chips to open 'over time': Huang

Nvidia boss Jensen Huang expects China to eventually open its market to high-end US chips that can train and run artificial intelligence systems. But he did not discuss sales of the powerful H200 model with top officials in Beijing, the businessman told Bloomberg Television in an interview broadcast Monday. Huang travelled to the country last week with US President Donald Trump, who met Chinese President Xi Jinping. The superpowers are in a fierce race for AI supremacy, and the H200 chip had until recently been barred from sale in China by Washington over national security concerns. However, there is no sign that Chinese tech companies are buying them, as Beijing ramps up domestic chip development in a bid to challenge US dominance in the key sector. "H200s are licensed to sell to China.

[NVDA] But the Chinese government has to decide how much of their local market do they want to protect," Huang said. "My sense is that over time the market will open," added Huang, CEO of Nvidia -- the world's most valuable company, due to huge demand for its AI hardware. Trump said in December he had reached an agreement with Xi to ease the restrictions on H200 chips, a move some US lawmakers have warned could help the Chinese military. Nvidia's most top-of-the-range offerings, the Blackwell and forthcoming Rubin series, remain banned for sale in China. Xi told a delegation of US business executives on Thursday that China would "open wider" to the world.

Mythos, announced on April 7, is being deployed as part of Anthropic's "Project Glasswing," a controlled ​initiative under which select organizations, including major tech firms such as Amazon,
Microsoft
,
Nvidia
and
Apple
, are permitted to use the unreleased Claude Mythos Preview model for defensive cybersecurity purposes. Mythos' capabilities to code at a high level have given it a potentially ‌unprecedented ability to identify cybersecurity ⁠vulnerabilities and devise ways to exploit them, according to experts. Last week, Anthropic began telling partners that they are generally permitted to disclose ⁠their involvement in Glasswing and, at their own discretion, share findings, best practices, tools or code developed through the program. "We fully support our partners sharing findings with each ​other and ​companies outside of Glasswing to triage vulnerabilities," ​an Anthropic spokesperson said in a ‌statement. "While there was never a specific Glasswing NDA, confidentiality protections were something partners asked for at the outset and were built into agreements partners signed."
The protections were included in agreements with participating companies under which the model is provided, after partners sought assurances before sharing sensitive findings and expressed concern about being targeted by ‌attackers. "As the program has matured, we've adapted them ​to ensure key information can be shared broadly - ​including outside the program - for maximum ​defensive impact," the spokesperson added.

records.answer:
Tesla 的汽車毛利率在最近六個月內呈上升趨勢（從 16.8% 提升至 18.7%），但在最新的三個月（Q2 2026）則小幅下降（從 17.2% 降至 16.9%），同時因為 Magnificent Seven 科技股全體下跌，Tesla 股價也受到整體拋售壓力而出現下跌【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #83】、【NVDA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。

- **毛利率變化**  
  - 六個月累計：2026 年 6 月 30 日止的六個月汽車毛利率為 **18.7%**，較 2025 年同期間的 **16.8%** 上升 **2.9 個百分點**【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #83】。  
  - 最近三個月（2026 Q2）：汽車毛利率為 **16.9%**，較 2025 Q2 的 **17.2%** 下降 **0.3 個百分點**【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #83】。  

- **股價訊號**  
  - Reuters 報導指出，因 SpaceX 即將 IPO，對沖基金在 IPO 前拋售了包括 Tesla 在內的所有 Magnificent Seven 科技股，導致這些股票自上週五以來皆出現下跌【NVDA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。

**結論**：Tesla 汽車毛利率在半年內改善，但最新季度略有回落；同時，Magnificent Seven 整體跌勢為 Tesla 股價帶來負面短期動能，投資者需同時關注毛利率趨勢與大盤科技股情緒的雙重影響。

records.query: NVIDIA 的核心技術護城河是什麼？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 的核心護城河在於其 **完整的硬體‑軟體 AI 平台**：領先的 GPU 與 CUDA 生態系統、資料中心規模的算力與網路、以及龐大的開發者社群，形成難以被競爭者複製的全方位價值鏈【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #19】【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21】。

- **GPU 硬體領先與大量運算核心**：NVIDIA 的 GPU 具備「數萬顆運算核心」的平行處理能力，是深度學習演算法的關鍵基礎【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21】。  
- **CUDA 軟體平台與開發者生態**：CUDA 作為所有 NVIDIA GPU 的基礎開發平台，配合「數百」領域專屬的函式庫、框架、SDK 與 API，讓開發者能直接在 GPU 上構建 AI 與圖形應用【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #19】。截至目前已有「超過 0.075 億（7.5 百萬）」開發者使用 CUDA 及相關工具【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #36】。  
- **全端 AI 軟硬體堆疊**：公司提供從硬體（GPU、CPU、DPU）到系統、網路、軟體（NVIDIA AI Enterprise、NVIDIA NIM、NeMo、AI Blueprints）以及演算法與模型的完整解決方案，形成「端到端」的加速計算平台【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #36】【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #22】。  
- **資料中心規模與極致協同設計**：Blackwell 架構在資料中心層面實現「極致協同設計」，可將「數十萬」GPU 互相連接成單一巨型電腦，提供前所未有的運算規模與效能【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #19】。  
- **網路與 DPU 能力**：透過 2020 年收購 Mellanox，NVIDIA 擴展至高效能網路，並推出資料處理單元（DPU），進一步完善資料中心的全棧基礎建設【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #22】。  
- **平台策略與生態價值**：公司以「硬體、系統、軟體、演算法、模型與資料」的整合平台策略，為多個「數十億美元」的終端市場提供統一的可程式化架構，並藉由龐大的開發者與已安裝基礎提升平台價值【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21】。  

以上各項相互支撐，形成 NVIDIA 在 AI、資料中心、電腦圖形與自動駕駛等領域的技術護城河，使競爭者難以同時匹配其硬體性能、軟體生態與規模化的整體解決方案。

Examples include generative AI, which can create new content such as text, code, images, audio, video, molecule structures, and recommendation systems; and agentic AI where systems of AI models work in concert to automatically complete a task. NVIDIA has a platform strategy, bringing together hardware, systems, software, algorithms, libraries, AI models and training data sets, and services to create unique value for the markets we serve. While the computing requirements of these end markets are diverse, we address them with a unified underlying programmable architecture allowing us to support several multi-billion-dollar end markets with the same underlying technology by using a variety of software stacks developed either internally or by third-party developers and partners. The large and growing number of developers and installed base across our platforms strengthens our ecosystem and increases the value of our platform for our customers.

records.query: Microsoft 如何把 Copilot 整合進 Microsoft 365 的產品策略？
records.answer:
Microsoft 把 Copilot 直接嵌入 Microsoft 365 的各項服務，作為 AI 助手在辦公、協作與分析功能中提升使用者體驗與每位使用者收入，成為產品策略的核心要素【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #58】。  

- 在 Microsoft 365 Commercial 平台中，Copilot 與 Office、Windows、Enterprise Mobility + Security、Power BI、Teams 等組件共同組成 AI‑powered 的業務與生產力解決方案，Microsoft 明確以「加入 AI‑enabled 工具、功能與 agentic 場景」來推動新市場與新使用者的成長【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #58】。  
- 2026 年第一季（截至 2026‑03‑31）Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端收入成長 19%，其中「Microsoft 365 E5」與「Microsoft 365 Copilot」帶動了每位使用者收入的提升【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #116】。  
- 同期 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端座位數也因小型與中型企業以及前線工作者的需求而增長 6%，顯示 Copilot 的功能已被廣泛部署於不同客戶群【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #116】。  
- 為支援 Copilot 座位與使用量的增長，Microsoft 在 AI 基礎設施上投入了 6.8 億美元的成本，說明公司正加大對 AI 計算資源與相關基礎設施的投資以確保 Copilot 的可用性與效能【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #116】。  
- 這些 AI 投資同時推動了毛利的提升，毛利增加 44 億美元（約 18%），主要受 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端的成長驅動，間接顯示 Copilot 的整合對整體盈利有正面貢獻【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #116】。  

綜合以上，Microsoft 透過在 Microsoft 365 產品組合中嵌入 Copilot，將 AI 功能深度結合於雲端服務與辦公應用，並以提升每位使用者收入、擴大座位數與加強 AI 基礎設施為主要策略方向。

records.query: Microsoft 如何靠 Windows 帶動雲端與 Copilot 相關服務的參與度？
records.answer:
Microsoft 透過將 Windows 與 Azure 雲端平台及 Microsoft 365 Copilot 深度整合，提升了雲端服務與 Copilot 相關產品的使用率與收入。

- 2025 年上半年（截至 12/31/2025）「Microsoft 365 Commercial 產品與雲端服務」的總收入較前一年增長 69 億美元（$6.9 billion），成長率 17%[MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #120]，其中雲端收入的 17% 成長部分受益於 Microsoft 365 Copilot 以及 Microsoft 365 E5 每位使用者收入提升。  
- 同期「Microsoft 365 Commercial 產品」收入亦因 Windows Commercial 內部部署元件的銷售貢獻，實現 15% 的增長[MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #120]，顯示 Windows 的企業版授權與服務仍是驅動產品收入的重要因素。  
- 整體「生產力與商務流程」部門的營收在同一期間增加 94 億美元（$9.4 billion），成長 16%，其中 Windows 相關的產品與服務是提升整體營收的關鍵推手之一[MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #120]。  

綜合上述，Microsoft 以 Windows 為入口，結合其雲端基礎設施與 AI‑Copilot 功能，既提升了 Windows 用戶向雲端服務的遷移，也透過 Copilot 增加每位使用者的平均收入，從而帶動雲端與 Copilot 相關服務的參與度與營收成長。

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS 基礎設施與 AI 領域（含與 Anthropic 的合作）的投資策略是什麼？
records.answer:
Amazon 正在採取持續加大 AWS 基礎設施與人工智慧（AI）相關支出的策略，並透過對 Anthropic 及 OpenAI 等前沿 AI 公司的股權投資與融資安排，確保取得先進算力與技術合作夥伴關係【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #206】。

- **預期支出持續上升**：公司在 2025 年的 10‑K 中指出，未來將持續增加技術與基礎設施的支出，特別是支援人工智慧與機器學習的相關投入，以提升長期成長與客戶體驗【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #206】。  
- **Anthropic 股權投資**：在 2026 年 3 月 31 日之後，Amazon 投資了 **50 億美元（$5.0 billion）** 於 Anthropic 的非投票優先股，作為其 AI 版圖的一環【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #39】。  
- **OpenAI 大規模承諾**：同一季節，Amazon 於 OpenAI 投入 **150 億美元（$15.0 billion）** 的 C 系列優先股，並簽署了額外 **350 億美元（$35.0 billion）** 的認購承諾，以在未來取得更多股份【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #39】。  
- **融資與額外投資選項**：Amazon 與 Anthropic 簽訂了最高 **200 億美元（$20.0 billion）** 的融資設施，允許 Anthropic 在達成算力交付里程碑後提取資金；同時 Amazon 保留最高 **50 億美元（$5.0 billion）** 的選擇權，可於未來的股權融資中進一步投資 Anthropic【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #39】。  
- **AWS 雲端服務與晶片合作**：公司亦修訂了主要提供 AWS 雲端服務且包含 AWS 晶片使用的商業安排，確保在 AI 計算需求上擁有自有晶片供應與服務整合【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #39】。  
- **基礎設施成本變化**：2026 年第二季及截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的六個月期間，技術與基礎設施成本較去年同期增加 **4.27 億美元（$427 million）**，主要因基礎設施（包括折舊與攤銷）的支出上升，顯示公司正將資金投入於擴大 AWS 資源與 AI 計算平台【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #80】。  

綜合上述，Amazon 的投資策略是透過提升 AWS 基礎設施支出、加大 AI/機器學習相關研發投入，並以股權投資、長期融資安排以及晶片供應合約等多元方式，與 Anthropic 及其他領先 AI 企業緊密合作，確保在雲端算力與生成式 AI 市場的領先地位。

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商業務上面臨哪些反壟斷或監管風險？
records.answer:
Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商平台面臨多項反壟斷與監管風險，主要包括競爭法與消費者保護調查、隱私與資料使用規範、以及稅務挑戰【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #160】。

- **競爭與反壟斷調查**：美國、加拿大、英國等地的州檢察長與聯邦貿易委員會已對 Amazon 的店舖營運、履行網路、Prime 服務以及 AWS 雲端服務提出多項競爭相關或消費者保護的指控，指稱可能違反反壟斷或不公平競爭規則【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #160】、【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #128】、【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #130】。

- **資料隱私與「門檻」規範**：隨著各國將大型科技公司視為線上「門檻」企業，Amazon 亦受到日益增長的資料收集、使用與披露相關法律的審查，未來可能因合規成本上升或被迫改變業務慣例而受影響【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #160】、【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #129】。

records.query: Google 如何把 Gemini AI 整合進搜尋與其他產品生態系？
records.answer:
Google 透過在搜尋功能與多項自家平台中直接嵌入 Gemini 大型語言模型，讓使用者在查詢、內容創作與企業應用上都能即時使用生成式 AI 的推理與多模態能力【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #130】。

- 在搜尋方面，Google 已將 Gemini 的先進推理與多模態技術加入「AI Overviews」與「AI Mode」功能，使使用者只要輸入自然語言問題，就能得到更完整、具上下文理解的回應，甚至能一次解決原本需要多次搜尋的複雜問題【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。  
- 這些 AI 功能是以 Gemini 模型為核心，已在所有 15 個「半億」使用者規模的產品（其中 7 個產品擁有 20 億使用者）中部署，確保從搜尋到其他服務皆能共享同一套 AI 能力【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #130】。  
- 除了消費者端的搜尋，Google 亦將 Gemini 以「Gemini Enterprise」與「Gemini for Google Workspace」的形式提供給 Google Cloud 客戶，協助企業在工作流程、文件處理與協作工具中嵌入生成式 AI，擴大 Gemini 在企業生態系的應用範圍【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #130】。  
- 為了支援這些 AI 服務，Alphabet 持續投資於技術基礎設施（伺服器、網路設備與資料中心），確保 Gemini 所需的大量運算資源能夠穩定供應，並透過模型設計與 TPU/GPU 基礎建設提升效能與成本效益【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #300】。  

總結來說，Google 以 Gemini 為核心 AI 引擎，先在搜尋的 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 中實作，然後擴散至 15 個主要產品與企業雲端服務，並同步加強底層硬體與研發投入，以支撐整個生態系的 AI 整合與商業化。

records.query: Google 搜尋如何演變出 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 來回應生成式 AI 對搜尋的衝擊？
records.answer:
Google 搜尋透過推出 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode，將傳統關鍵字搜尋演變成以自然語言與多模態生成式 AI 回應的體驗，先聚焦提升使用者體驗，再逐步考量變現機會【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #300】。

1. **AI Overviews**：讓使用者只要輸入問題，即可直接得到一段簡潔且有用的回應，減少必須自行瀏覽多筆搜尋結果的需求【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。此功能是 Google 以「先提升使用者體驗、再考慮變現」的策略推出的其中一環【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #300】。

2. **AI Mode**：針對更複雜或需多步推理的查詢，使用 Gemini 模型的先進推理、思考與多模態能力，讓使用者能以更細緻的方式提出問題，並得到更深入的答案【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。

3. **因應生成式 AI 衝擊的整體布局**  
   - Google 明確表示在開發新產品與服務時，會先著重使用者體驗，之後才考量如何貨幣化，這與 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 的推出時程相符【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #300】。  
   - 同時，公司預期 AI 相關產品與服務的收入增長速度可能高於傳統廣告收入，且這些新收入的毛利率普遍低於廣告毛利率，顯示 Google 正在調整收入結構以因應生成式 AI 帶來的市場變化【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #300】。  
   - 為支撐 AI 需求，Google 正大幅投資技術基礎設施（伺服器、網路設備、資料中心），以提供足夠的運算資源，確保 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 能在規模上持續運作【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #300】。  
   - 公司亦提到面臨來自其他 AI 產品與服務開發者的激烈競爭，這可能影響未來的收入與毛利率走勢，顯示 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 也是在競爭壓力下的防禦與差異化策略【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #300】。

records.query: Meta 在 AI 與 Reality Labs 上的長期願景與投資方向是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 的長期願景是以 AI、穿戴裝置與虛擬/擴增實境技術，打造下一代的沉浸式「元宇宙」平台，並在未來十年內持續投入長期研發與基礎建設。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #116]

- Meta 認為元宇宙是「下一個社交科技的演進」，因此自 2021 年起將業務與產品策略調整為「幫助將元宇宙帶入生活」，聚焦於 AI、可穿戴裝置與裝置介面等創新領域。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #63]  
- 這項計畫被描述為「複雜、持續演變且長期」的倡議，需要開發新興技術、持續投資基礎設施、以及在隱私、安全、競爭與內容規範等多項法規層面的合規工作，並與其他公司、開發者、合作夥伴共同合作。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #63]  
- 為了支撐這些長期目標，Meta 正在投入「長期、前沿的研發」於尚未上市的產品，這些產品可能要到「下一個十年」才會完整實現，重點包括 AI 與硬體的創新，以構建下一代介面。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #116]  
- 在較近的階段，Meta 已推出多項 VR 與 AR 相關產品：Meta Quest 系列與 Meta Horizon Store 的軟體內容、具「透視」功能的沉浸式體驗、以及搭載 Meta AI 的 Ray‑Ban Meta 與 Oakley Meta 智慧眼鏡；2024 年展示的 Orion 原型眼鏡提供業界領先的視野與佩戴舒適度；2025 年推出的 Meta Ray‑Ban Display 結合 AI 眼鏡與鏡片內建顯示，並配合使用肌電訊號控制的 Meta Neural Band 手環。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #117]  
- 這些短期與長期的產品與研發計畫皆旨在「推動更大的 VR 採用與接受度」以及「持續發展 AR 眼鏡」的市場，並透過 AI 助理與硬體創新，建立下一代的使用者介面與互動方式。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #117]  

總結來說，Meta 的長期願景是透過 AI、硬體與穿戴技術，打造一個以沉浸式體驗為核心的元宇宙生態系，並在未來十年內持續投入前瞻研發、基礎設施與跨產業合作，以實現這一長期目標。

records.query: Meta 的廣告獲利模式與 Meta AI 在旗下 App 中扮演的角色是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 主要透過在其 Family of Apps（包括 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger、Threads、WhatsApp）上投放廣告來獲利，同時在所有這些應用程式中嵌入 Meta AI，讓使用者在瀏覽、聊天或創作內容時能即時取得 AI 助手的協助【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #209】、【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #113】。

**廣告獲利模式**  
- Meta 以「每則廣告的平均價格」作為衡量指標，計算方式為「總廣告收入 ÷ 投放的廣告數量」，此價格不受廣告主的具體目標（曝光或行動）影響【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #209】。  
- 廣告收入會因產品而異，例如 Video 與 Reels 的變現率目前低於 Feed 或 Stories，Meta 會根據產品與變現策略「增加或減少」廣告的數量與頻率【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #209】。  
- 若廣告收入安排中 Meta 不是主要方，則以「淨額」認列收入【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #209】。  
- 除廣告外，Meta 亦有「其他收入」來源，包括 WhatsApp 的付費訊息、Meta Verified 訂閱等【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #209】。

**Meta AI 在各 App 中的角色**  
- Meta AI 是一個跨平台的 AI 助手，除了在獨立的 AI 應用程式外，亦內嵌於 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger、Threads、WhatsApp 等所有主要應用，協助使用者「學習、完成任務、創作內容、連結他人」【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #113】、【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1】。  
- 在 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger 等產品中，Meta AI 以聊天、內容建議、搜尋等功能提升使用者互動與留存，並在 AI 眼鏡與網路上提供相同的助理服務，形成「全域 AI 生態系」【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1】。  
- 透過這樣的整合，Meta AI 不僅增強了每個應用程式的功能性，也為廣告平台提供更精準的受眾洞察與個人化廣告投放的基礎。  

總結而言，Meta 以廣告投放與相關的平均價格為核心營收來源，並以 Meta AI 作為全平台的智慧助理，提升使用者體驗與廣告變現效率。

records.query: Tesla 如何把自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）技術當作與競爭對手的核心差異化？
records.answer:
Tesla 把全自動駕駛（FSD）與 AI 軟體功能作為與競爭對手的核心差異化，因為每一台交付的車輛皆內建可透過 OTA（over‑the‑air）更新的自動駕駛能力，且公司聲稱其 AI 能力「與競爭者不同」​[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #39]。

- **全車設計即具備自動駕駛基礎**：Tesla 表示「每一輛今天交付的 Tesla 車輛皆為自動駕駛而設計」​[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #39]，這意味著硬體平台從一開始就支援未來的自動駕駛功能，而非後裝套件。  
- **AI 與軟體持續升級**：公司透過 OTA 軟體更新不斷提升安全與便利功能，類似航空領域的飛行員系統，讓車主在條件允許時可減少駕駛介入​[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #39]。  
- **FSD（Supervised）功能與產品路線**：在 2025 年度的 10‑K 中，Tesla 明確將 FSD（Supervised）列為「等同於 FSD（Capability）」的命名，並持續在歐洲、亞太等市場推廣此功能​[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #34]。  
- **Robotaxi 服務作為差異化延伸**：2025 年 6 月推出的 Robotaxi 服務，利用已開發的自動駕駛與 AI 技術，提供自主叫車平台，進一步將自動駕駛商業化，形成與傳統汽車製造商不同的服務驅動商業模式​[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #34]。  
- **成本與定價優勢**：Tesla 強調透過 AI 功能提升車輛性能與功能，同時以成本創新與本地化採購維持競爭性價格，這使得其自動駕駛技術不僅是技術差異，也是提升整體產品吸引力的關鍵​[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #153]。  

綜合以上，Tesla 以全車自動駕駛設計、持續的 AI 軟體升級、FSD（Supervised）功能的全球化推廣，以及以 Robotaxi 為代表的服務化應用，形成與其他汽車品牌在技術、產品與商業模式上的明顯差異化​[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #39][TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #34][TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #153]。

contexts: [TSLA 10-K period 2025] [section: Self-Driving Development and Artificial Intelligence] Although at present, same as in the past, the driver is responsible for remaining fully engaged in the driving operation, these systems provide safety and convenience functionality that may relieve drivers of many tedious and potentially dangerous aspects of road travel much like the system that airplane pilots use, when conditions permit. As with other vehicle systems, we improve these functions in our customer vehicles through over-the-air software updates. Every Tesla vehicle delivered today is designed for autonomy, and we believe our capabilities and advancements in AI differentiate us from our competitors.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] [section: Automotive and AI Enabled Products—Production] For example, changes to fiscal and trade policy with respect to tariffs, export controls and other restrictions may impact our global supply chain cost structure and availability, affecting not only vehicle production, but also facility expansions. Moreover, we have set ambitious technological targets with our plans for battery cells as well as for iterative manufacturing and design improvements for our vehicles. Automotive and AI Enabled Products—Demand, Sales, Deliveries and Infrastructure

Our cost reduction efforts, cost innovation strategies, and additional localized procurement and manufacturing are key to our vehicles’ affordability and have allowed us to competitively price our vehicles. We will also continue to generate demand by improving our vehicles’ performance and functionality, including through product offerings and features utilizing artificial intelligence such as FSD (Supervised) and other software, and delivering new vehicles and vehicle options. In addition, we believe the launch of our Robotaxi service unlocks the potential for significant business growth to advance a service-driven business model. We will continue to improve safety and profitability while scaling the network. In addition, we have been increasing awareness, and expanding our vehicle financing programs, including attractive leasing terms for our customers. We will also continue to work on developing our robotics offerings. However, we operate in a cyclical industry that is sensitive to shifting consumer trends, political and regulatory uncertainty, including with respect to trade and the environment, all of which can be compounded by inflationary pressures, rising energy prices, interest rate fluctuations and the liquidity of enterprise customers. For example, as inflationary pressures increased across the markets in which we operate, central banks in developed countries raised interest rates rapidly and substantially, which impacted the affordability of vehicle lease and finance arrangements. Further, sales of vehicles in the automotive industry also tend to be cyclical in many markets, which may expose us to increased volatility as we expand and adjust our operations. Moreover, as additional competitors enter the marketplace and help bring the world closer to sustainable transportation, we will have to adjust and continue to execute well to maintain our momentum. Additionally, our suppliers’ liquidity and allocation plans may be affected by current challenges in the automotive industry, which could reduce our access to components or result in unfavorable changes to cost. These macroeconomic and industry trends have had, and will likely continue to have, an impact on the pricing of, and order rate for our vehicles, and in turn our operating margin. Changes in government and economic policies, incentives or tariffs may also impact our production, cost structure and the competitive landscape. For instance, while the final scope and application of recently announced changes in trade policy remain uncertain at this time, higher tariffs on imports and subsequent retaliatory tariffs could adversely impact consumer spending and demand for durable goods and related services. Furthermore, certain provisions of the OBBBA, including the removal of tax credits for electric vehicles, may also impact consumer demand for electric vehicles in general. We will continue to adjust accordingly to such developments, and we believe our ongoing cost reduction efforts, including through production innovation, process improvements and logistics optimization, and focus on operating leverage, vertical integration and supply chain localization will continue to benefit us in relation to our competitors. Our new products and our advances in autonomy and robotics, position us for future growth. 32

As our vehicle production increases, we must work constantly to similarly increase vehicle delivery capability so that it does not become a bottleneck on our total deliveries. As we expand our manufacturing operations globally, we will also have to continue to increase and staff our delivery, servicing and charging infrastructure accordingly, maintain our vehicle reliability and optimize our Supercharger locations to ensure cost effectiveness and customer satisfaction. In particular, as other automotive manufacturers have announced their adoption of NACS and agreements with us to utilize our Superchargers, we must correspondingly expand our network in order to ensure adequate availability to meet customer demands. We also remain focused on continued enhancements of the capability and efficiency of our servicing operations. records.query: Tesla 在電動車市場面臨什麼樣的競爭態勢？
records.answer:
Tesla 在電動車市場面臨「高度且日益加劇的競爭」——大量既有車廠與新進者同時投入電動與替代燃料車款，且在自駕技術與能源服務領域也有激烈的對手。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #79][TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #100]

- **多元競爭者**：全球汽車市場正被「既有與新興汽車製造商」以及其他公司所擠佔，這些企業正陸續推出或計畫推出電動、混合、插電式混合及全電動車型。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #79][TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #100]

- **傳統內燃機車的競爭**：Tesla 的車款除了與同類別的電動車競爭外，還必須與「傳統內燃機車」爭奪同一細分市場，例如 Cybertruck 與其他皮卡、Model S/X 與高階轎車與 SUV、Model 3/Y 與緊湊型轎車與 SUV。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #79]

- **自駕與軟體平台的競爭**：在自動駕駛解決方案與車載軟體平台方面，Tesla 也面臨「越來越多的既有與新興競爭者」的挑戰，包括其他汽車製造商與專門的科技公司。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #100]

- **政府與經濟激勵的影響**：部分政府與經濟激勵措施可能偏向在本地組裝或使用本地供應鏈的競爭對手，這可能削弱 Tesla 的獲利能力。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #100]

- **資源與成本優勢**：許多競爭者擁有「更充足或更成熟的資源」來投入設計、開發、製造、分銷、行銷與售後服務，且因地理與經濟環境可取得成本效益，可能導致 Tesla 的車輛單位銷量下降、價格被迫下調、營收短缺、失去客戶與市場佔有率。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #100]

- **能源產業的競爭**：在能源產生與儲存業務方面，Tesla 同樣面臨來自其他製造商、開發商、安裝商與大型公用事業公司的競爭，且電價下降亦可能削弱其產品吸引力，增加客戶違約風險。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #100]

records.query: Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務在公司整體策略中扮演什麼角色？
records.answer:
Tesla 把能源生成與儲能業務定位為與汽車事業平行的核心事業，旨在成為全方位的清潔能源供應商【TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。  

- 這一業務構成公司第二大事業部門，與汽車部門共同構成公司的兩大營運分部【TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 在能源生成與儲能分部，Tesla 透過網站、實體店面、展廳以及渠道合作夥伴，向住宅、商業、工業客戶與公用事業銷售太陽能與儲能產品，並在部分商業客戶採用電力購買協議（PPA）模式【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #54】。  
- 公司強調「簡化、標準化與可取得性」的策略，讓客戶更容易且具成本效益地採用清潔能源，同時降低客戶取得成本【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #54】。  
- 為了實現上述目標，Tesla 依賴其在電氣、機械、土木與軟體工程方面的專業，設計、製造與安裝能源產生與儲存產品與組件，從住宅規模到公用事業規模皆能提供解決方案【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #48】。  
- 例如，Megapack 產品的整合式設計大幅減少現場組裝工作量，提升部署效率；同時，Tesla 亦提供客製化的儲能與太陽能系統（含 Solar Roof）以符合客戶特定需求【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #48】。  

綜合以上，能源生成與儲能業務不僅是 Tesla 的第二大營運分部，亦是公司透過技術與服務將業務版圖從電動車擴展至全套清潔能源解決方案的關鍵支點。

records.query: Apple 的第三方開發者生態系相對於 Android、Windows 等平台的黏著度是如何建立的？
records.answer:
Apple 透過「讓開發者感受到在 iOS 平台上開發與服務能帶來較高的收益與成長機會」來提升第三方開發者的黏著度，並以 App Store 佣金與分潤機制作為持續合作的經濟誘因，同時也因為 iPhone、iPad、Mac 等硬體的市場佔有率較 Android、Windows 較低，必須不斷強化這些感知利益才能維持開發者的投入。[AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #124]  

- **感知利益與市場規模**：Apple 認為開發者是否願意投入資源，取決於「在 Apple 產品上創造軟體與服務的預期收益、未來產品銷售成長以及開發成本」相較於 Android（手機與平板）與 Windows（個人電腦與平板）的競爭平台之比較。[AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #124]  

- **市場佔有率的影響**：Apple 在全球智慧手機、個人電腦、平板與穿戴裝置的市場佔有率屬於少數，這會使開發者較不願意將資源投入 Apple 生態系，因而必須透過更具吸引力的收益模型與技術支援來提升黏著度。[AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #124]  

- **App Store 佣金與分潤**：Apple 透過 App Store 向第三方應用程式與數位內容收取佣金，若開發者改用直接對消費者銷售或其他分銷管道，Apple 可能失去佣金收入，這會「實質影響公司營收、毛利、營運結果與股價」；因此，Apple 需要提供足夠的分潤與曝光機會，讓開發者仍願意在其平台上發佈產品。[AAPL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #36]  

- **內容與服務授權**：Apple 與多家第三方內容供應商簽訂短期授權合約，若未能續約或條件不佳，將削減平台上可供消費者選擇的內容，進一步影響開發者對平台的信心與黏著度。[AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #125]  

- **人才與創新投入**：Apple 亦強調「高技能員工與創新人才」對平台生態的重要性，持續投入研發與人才招募，以確保平台能提供最新技術與工具，讓開發者在 iOS 生態系中保持競爭力。[AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #125]  

綜合以上，Apple 透過提升開發者在 iOS 上的收益預期、維持有競爭力的 App Store 佣金結構、確保內容授權的穩定性，以及持續投入技術與人才，來建立相對於 Android、Windows 等平台的開發者黏著度。

Experienced personnel in the technology industry are in high demand and competition for their talents is intense, especially in Silicon Valley, where most of the Company’s key personnel are located. Periods of intense competition for talent in particular fields can lead to increased costs as the Company seeks to offer competitive compensation to recruit and retain highly skilled employees.

[GOOGL 10-Q period 202606] Product sales revenue from hardware, net of estimated allowances for returns, and software is recognized generally when control of the hardware is transferred to the customer. Installation, support, and extended warranty services revenue are recognized ratably over the service period or as services are performed. Arrangements with Multiple Performance Obligations

At contract inception, we assess whether concurrent agreements with a customer should be accounted for as a single agreement. Our contracts with customers may include multiple performance obligations. For such arrangements, we allocate revenues to each performance obligation based on its relative standalone selling price. 11


Alphabet Inc. We generally determine standalone selling prices based on observable prices of our products and services sold or priced separately in comparable circumstances to similar customers. Customer Incentives and Credits

Certain customers receive cash-based incentives or credits, which are accounted for as variable consideration. We estimate these amounts based on the expected amount to be provided to customers and reduce revenues. We believe that there will not be significant changes to our estimates of variable consideration related to customer incentives and credits. Sales Commissions

We expense sales commissions when incurred when the period of the expected benefit is one year or less. We recognize an asset for certain sales commissions and amortize if the expected benefit period is greater than one year. These costs are recorded within sales and marketing expenses. Cost of Revenues

Cost of revenues consists of traffic acquisition costs (TAC) and other costs of revenues. •TAC includes:

◦amounts paid to our distribution partners who make available our search access points and other ad-supported services. Our distribution partners include browser providers, mobile carriers, original equipment manufacturers, and software developers; and

◦amounts paid to Google Network partners primarily for ads displayed on their properties. •Other cost of revenues includes:

◦content acquisition costs, which are payments to content providers from whom we license video and other content for distribution, primarily related to YouTube (we pay fees to these content providers based on revenues generated, subscriber counts, or a flat fee);

◦depreciation expense, primarily related to our technical infrastructure;

◦employee compensation expenses related to our technical infrastructure and other operations such as content review and customer and product support;

◦inventory and other costs related to the devices and TPU system hardware we sell; and

◦other technical infrastructure operations costs, including energy, equipment, and network capacity costs. Inventory

Inventory consists primarily of hardware related to TPU systems for sale to enterprise customers and devices, which primarily include the Pixel family of products. We utilize third-party contract manufacturers to manufacture our inventory. Our inventory includes raw material components purchased directly from our suppliers; work-in-process inventory undergoing conversion into finished products; and fully assembled finished goods. Inventories are stated at the lower of cost or net realizable value. Acquired Intangible Assets

Intangible assets with definite lives are amortized over their estimated useful lives on a straight-line basis generally over periods ranging from one to 10 years, and are subsequently removed from the presentation of gross intangible assets and accumulated amortization once they are fully amortized. Assets Held for Sale

We consider assets to be held for sale in the period when all of the criteria for a qualifying plan of sale are met. Upon designation as held for sale, we record the assets at the lower of their carrying value or their estimated fair value, reduced for the cost to sell the assets, and cease depreciation. Long-lived assets classified as held for sale are measured at fair value on a nonrecurring basis.

[GOOGL 10-Q period 202606] Information about Segments and Geographic Areas 

We report our segment results as Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets:

•Google Services includes products and services such as ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Google Maps, Google Play, Search, and YouTube. Google Services generates revenues primarily from advertising; fees received for consumer subscription-based products such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, and NFL Sunday Ticket, as well as Google One; the sale of apps and in-app purchases; and devices. •Google Cloud includes infrastructure and platform services, applications, and other products and services for enterprise customers. Google Cloud generates services revenues primarily from consumption-based fees and subscriptions received for Google Cloud Platform services, Google Workspace communication and collaboration tools, and other enterprise services. Google Cloud generates product revenues primarily from the sale of TPU systems. •Other Bets is a combination of multiple operating segments that are not individually material. Revenues from Other Bets are generated primarily from the sale of autonomous transportation services and internet services. 39

Revenues, certain costs, such as costs associated with content and traffic acquisition, certain engineering activities, and inventory, as well as certain operating expenses are directly attributable to our segments. [MSFT 10-K period 2026] [section: Competition] Competition 

Windows faces competition from various software products and from alternative platforms and devices. We believe Windows competes effectively by giving customers choice, value, flexibility, security, an easy-to-use interface, and compatibility with a broad range of hardware and software applications, including those that enable productivity. Devices face competition from various computer, tablet, and hardware manufacturers who offer a unique combination of high-quality industrial design and innovative technologies across various price points. Many of these manufacturers are also current or potential partners and customers, including our Windows OEMs. XBOX and our cloud gaming services face competition from various online gaming ecosystems and game streaming services. Our gaming platform competes with other console platforms. We believe our gaming platform is effectively positioned against, and uniquely differentiated from, competitive products and services based on significant innovation in hardware architecture, user interface, developer tools, online gaming and entertainment services, and continued strong content from our own first-party game franchises as well as other digital content offerings. Our Search advertising business competes with search engines, and a wide array of websites, social platforms, and portals that provide content and online offerings to end users.

[GOOGL 10-K period 2025] [section: Risks Specific to our Company] Table of Contents

Alphabet Inc. Within Google Services, we continue to invest heavily in devices, including our smartphones, home devices, and wearables, which is a highly competitive market with frequent introduction of new products and services, rapid adoption of technological advancements by competitors, increased market saturation in developed countries, short product life cycles, evolving industry standards, continual improvement in performance characteristics, and price and feature sensitivity on the part of consumers and businesses. There can be no assurance we will be able to provide devices that compete effectively. Within Google Cloud, we devote significant resources to develop and deploy our enterprise-ready cloud services, including Google Cloud Platform and Google Workspace, and we are advancing our AI platforms and models to support these tools and technologies, including the development of our custom TPUs and how we deliver them to our customers. In addition, new and evolving products and services, including those that use AI, raise ethical, technological, legal, regulatory, and other challenges, which could harm our brands and demand for our products and services. Because all of these investment areas are inherently risky, no assurance can be given that such strategies and offerings will be successful or will not harm our reputation, financial condition, and operating results. We face intense competition. If we do not continue to innovate and provide products and services that are useful to users, customers, and other partners, we may not remain competitive, which could harm our business, financial condition, and operating results. Our business environment is rapidly evolving and intensely competitive. Our businesses face changing technologies, shifting user needs, and frequent introductions of rival products and services. To compete successfully, we must accurately anticipate technology developments and deliver innovative, relevant, and useful products, services, and technologies in a timely manner. For example, with the rise of AI in recent years, we have increasingly focused our investments in building powerful AI tools and AI enhancements to our existing products and services to better cater to our users, customers, and other partners. As our businesses evolve, the competitive pressure to innovate will encompass a wider range of products and services. We must continue to invest significant resources in technical infrastructure, including the development of our custom TPUs, and research and development, including through acquisitions, in order to enhance our technology, products, and services. We have many competitors in different industries.

[MSFT 10-K period 2026] [section: What We Offer] What We Offer

Founded in 1975, we develop and support software, services, devices, and solutions that deliver new value for customers and help people and businesses realize their full potential. We offer an array of services, including cloud-based solutions that provide customers with AI, software, services, platforms, and content, and we provide solution support and consulting services. We also deliver relevant online advertising to a global audience. Our products include operating systems, server applications, business solution applications, software development tools, desktop and server management tools, and video games. We also design and sell devices, including PCs, tablets, gaming and entertainment consoles, other intelligent devices, and related accessories. Digital transformation and adoption of AI continues to revolutionize more business workstreams for organizations in every sector across the globe. For enterprises, digital technology empowers employees, optimizes operations, engages customers, and in some cases, changes the very core of products and services. The Microsoft Cloud provides integration across the technology stack while offering openness, improving time to value, reducing costs, and increasing agility. Our cloud business benefits from three economies of scale: datacenters that deploy computational resources at significantly lower cost per unit than smaller ones; datacenters that coordinate and aggregate diverse customer, geographic, and application demand patterns, improving the utilization of computing, storage, and network resources; and multi-tenancy locations that lower application maintenance labor costs. We prioritize security above all else and we offer our customers integrated AI-driven products addressing security, compliance, identity, management, and privacy across customers’ multi-cloud, application, and device assets.

During Q2 2026, net sales from our International segment accounted for 21% of our consolidated revenues. The results of operations of, and certain of our intercompany balances associated with, our internationally-focused stores and AWS are exposed to foreign exchange rate fluctuations. Upon consolidation, as foreign exchange rates vary, net sales and other operating results may differ materially from expectations, and we may record significant gains or losses on the remeasurement of intercompany balances. For example, as a result of fluctuations in foreign exchange rates throughout the period compared to rates in effect the prior year, International segment net sales in Q2 2026 decreased by $82 million in comparison with Q2 2025. We have foreign exchange risk related to foreign-denominated cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities (“foreign funds”). Based on the balance of foreign funds as of June 30, 2026, of $20.4 billion, an assumed 5%, 10%, and 20% adverse change to foreign exchange rates would result in declines of $1.0 billion, $2.0 billion, and $4.1 billion. We also have foreign exchange risk related to our intercompany balances denominated in various currencies. Based on the intercompany balances as of June 30, 2026, an assumed 5%, 10%, and 20% adverse change to foreign exchange rates would result in losses of $400 million, $795 million, and $1.6 billion, recorded to “Other income (expense), net.”

Asked about investor concerns over Microsoft concentration, Jiang said AvePoint has operated in the Microsoft ecosystem for more than 20 years but does not depend on Microsoft as a reseller. He said Microsoft does not resell AvePoint’s products, and AvePoint helps customers complete “last mile” adoption of workloads such as Purview, E5 and Copilot. He said AvePoint is complementary to hyperscalers because it helps customers manage different license types and workloads across multiple platforms. On Microsoft 365 backup, Jiang said Microsoft Office Cloud has roughly 400 million to 500 million user seats, while AvePoint covers “tens of millions” of seats and is not yet at 100 million. He said the company still sees room for growth, while also incorporating Microsoft’s Backup Express snapshot capability into its own backup stack. Jiang said many customers use a mix of license levels, noting that E5 penetration remains below 20% and Copilot penetration is about 5%, according to his comments. He said AvePoint helps customers maximize existing investments rather than pushing them toward the highest-cost licenses. Multi-Cloud Expansion and SaaS Model
Jiang said AvePoint expects non-Microsoft revenue to rise to more than 30% of its mix as the company pursues its goal of reaching $1 billion in annual recurring revenue. He said non-Microsoft revenue is currently less than 10%. He said the company already has product coverage across ecosystems including Google, Salesforce, Atlassian, ServiceNow and AWS, but go-to-market development takes time because each ecosystem has different partners and channels. Jiang also highlighted AvePoint’s SaaS-heavy model. He said 88% of revenue is recurring and that AvePoint runs on hyperscaler infrastructure across GCP, Azure, AWS and U.S. government data centers. Jiang said AgentPulse is monetized through AvePoint’s “best” Control bundle and is helping increase Control deal sizes. records.answer:

Revenue growth in the first quarter was driven by data center products for accelerated computing and AI solutions. Blackwell continued to account for the majority of our system shipments. [NVDA 10-K period 2026] [section: Data Center] Data Center

The NVIDIA Data Center platform is focused on accelerating compute-intensive workloads, such as AI, data processing, graphics, robotics, and scientific computing, delivering superior total cost of ownership relative to conventional CPU-only approaches. It is deployed in cloud, hyperscale, on-premises and edge data centers. The platform consists of data center compute and networking infrastructure offerings typically delivered to customers as rack-scale systems, subsystems, or modules, along with software and services. Our Data Center infrastructure systems include supercomputing platforms and servers, bringing together our higher performance, energy efficient GPUs, CPUs, interconnects, and fully optimized AI and HPC software stacks. In addition, they include a growing body of acceleration libraries, AI models and training data sets, APIs, SDKs, and domain-specific application frameworks. Our networking offerings include NVLink interconnects and switches, end-to-end platforms for InfiniBand and Ethernet, consisting of network adapters, cables, DPUs, switch chips and systems, as well as software. This has enabled us to architect data center-scale computing platforms that can interconnect up to hundreds of thousands of compute nodes with high-performance networking. Fueled by an expansion in AI and HPC workloads, the data center has become the new unit of computing, with networking as an integral part. In fiscal year 2026, we introduced NVIDIA NVLink Fusion to enable hyperscalers and custom ASIC designers to integrate custom CPUs and XPUs with our platform. Our customers include all major public and private cloud providers, AI model makers, enterprises and startups, and public sector entities.

[NVDA 10-Q period 202604] In August 2022, the USG announced export restrictions and export licensing requirements targeting China’s semiconductor and supercomputing industries. These restrictions impacted exports of certain chips, as well as software, hardware, equipment and technology used to develop, produce and manufacture certain chips to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and Russia, and specifically impact our A100 and H100 integrated circuits, DGX or any other systems or boards which incorporate A100 or H100 integrated circuits. In July 2023, the USG also informed us of an additional licensing requirement for a subset of A100 and H100 products destined to certain customers and other regions, including some countries in the Middle East. In October 2023, the USG announced new and updated licensing requirements for exports to China and Country Groups D:1, D:4, and D:5 (including but not limited to, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Vietnam, but excluding Israel) of our products exceeding certain performance thresholds, including, but not limited to, the A100, A800, H100, H800, L4, L40, L40S RTX 4090, GB200 NVL72, and B200. The licensing requirements also apply to the export of products exceeding certain performance thresholds to a party headquartered in, or with an ultimate parent headquartered in, Country Group D5, including China. In April 2025, the USG informed us that it requires a license for export to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and D:5 countries, or to companies headquartered or with an ultimate parent therein, of our H20 integrated circuits and any other circuits achieving the H20’s memory bandwidth, interconnect bandwidth, or combination thereof. As a result of these requirements, we incurred a $4.5 billion charge in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026 associated with H20 for excess inventory and purchase obligations, as the demand for H20 products diminished. Beginning in August 2025, the USG granted licenses that would allow us to ship certain H20 products to certain China-based customers. USG officials expressed an expectation that the USG will receive 15% or more of the revenue generated from licensed sales of our products, but the USG did not publish a regulation codifying such requirement. Beginning in February 2026, the USG granted licenses that would allow us to ship small amounts of H200 products to specific China-based customers. To date, we have not generated any revenue under the H200 licensing program, and do not yet know whether any imports will be allowed into China. The license requires that the H200s go through an inspection process in the United States prior to any shipment to the customer. As a result, any H200 shipped under the new licensing program will be subject to a 25% tariff upon importation into the United States. In the event that we are able to sell licensed products into the China market, we may not be able to pass along all or any of the tariff to our customers, and may be subject to litigation, increased costs, and a harmed competitive position. The export controls applicable to China are complex and address a variety of parameters, including the total processing performance of a chip, the “performance density” of a chip, the interconnect bandwidth of a chip, and the memory bandwidth of a chip. Under the current rules and geopolitical landscape, we are unable to create and deliver a competitive product for China’s data center market that receives approval from both the USG and the Chinese government. As of the end of the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, while we were able to ship uncontrolled products to China, such as gaming and workstation GPUs, we were effectively foreclosed from competing in China's data center computing/compute market, and our effective foreclosure from the China market helped our competitors build larger developer and customer ecosystems to challenge us worldwide. Unless we are able to return with a data center system that meets the approval of both the USG and the Chinese government, our lost opportunity and the benefit to our competitors will have a material and adverse impact on our business, operating results, and financial condition.

The expenses include stock-based compensation expense, corporate infrastructure and support costs, acquisition-related and other costs, and other non-recurring charges and benefits that our CODM deems to be enterprise in nature. Our CODM does not review any information regarding total assets on a reportable segment basis. There are no intersegment transactions. The accounting policies for segment reporting are the same as for our consolidated financial statements.

[NVDA 10-K period 2026] [section: Our Company] Innovation is at our core. We have invested over $76.7 billion in research and development since our inception, yielding inventions that are essential to modern computing. Our invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market and redefined computer graphics. With our introduction of CUDA in 2006, we opened the parallel processing capabilities of our GPU to a broad range of compute-intensive applications, paving the way for the emergence of modern AI. In 2012, the AlexNet neural network, trained on NVIDIA GPUs, won the ImageNet computer image recognition competition, marking the “Big Bang” moment of AI. We introduced our first Tensor Core GPU in 2017, built from the ground-up for the new era of AI, and our first autonomous driving system-on-chips, or SoC, in 2018. Our acquisition of Mellanox in 2020 expanded our offerings to include networking, enabled our platforms to be data center scale, and led to the introduction of a new processor class – the data processing unit, or DPU. Over the past 5 years, we have built full software stacks that run on top of our GPUs and CUDA to bring AI to the world’s largest industries, including NVIDIA DRIVE stack for autonomous driving, Clara for healthcare, Omniverse for physical AI applications, and NVIDIA AI Enterprise software – essentially an operating system for enterprise AI applications. In 2023, we introduced our first data center CPU, Grace, built for giant-scale AI and high-performance computing, or HPC. In 2024, we launched the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture – connecting 36 Grace CPUs and 72 Blackwell GPUs in a data center scale, liquid-cooled design – for real-time trillion-parameter inference and training. In fiscal year 2026, we launched and scaled the NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra platform, optimized for agentic, reasoning, and physical AI. Building on the architectural breakthroughs of Blackwell and leveraging Dynamo inference software, it delivers a significant increase in token throughput and reduction in cost per token compared to the Hopper generation. More recently, in support of market development, we have accelerated the release cadence of our open AI model platforms including NVIDIA Nemotron for agentic AI and Cosmos for physical AI. With a strong engineering culture, we drive fast, yet harmonized, product and technology innovations in all dimensions of computing including silicon, systems, networking, software and algorithms.

[NVDA 10-Q period 202510] During the third quarter of fiscal year 2023, the USG announced export restrictions and export licensing requirements targeting China’s semiconductor and supercomputing industries. These restrictions impacted exports of certain chips, as well as software, hardware, equipment and technology used to develop, produce and manufacture certain chips to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and Russia, and specifically impact our A100 and H100 integrated circuits, DGX or any other systems or boards which incorporate A100 or H100 integrated circuits. During the second quarter of fiscal year 2024, the USG also informed us of an additional licensing requirement for a subset of A100 and H100 products destined to certain customers and other regions, including some countries in the Middle East. During the third quarter of fiscal year 2024, the USG announced new and updated licensing requirements for exports to China and Country Groups D:1, D:4, and D:5 (including but not limited to, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Vietnam, but excluding Israel) of our products exceeding certain performance thresholds, including, but not limited to, the A100, A800, H100, H800, L4, L40, L40S RTX 4090, GB200 NVL72, and B200. The licensing requirements also apply to the export of products exceeding certain performance thresholds to a party headquartered in, or with an ultimate parent headquartered in, Country Group D5, including China. On April 9, 2025, the USG informed us that it requires a license for export to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and D:5 countries, or to companies headquartered or with an ultimate parent therein, of our H20 integrated circuits and any other circuits achieving the H20’s memory bandwidth, interconnect bandwidth, or combination thereof. As a result of these new requirements, we incurred a $4.5 billion charge in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026 associated with H20 for excess inventory and purchase obligations, as the demand for H20 products diminished. The export controls applicable to China are complex and address a variety of parameters, including the total processing performance of a chip, the “performance density” of a chip, the interconnect bandwidth of a chip, and the memory bandwidth of a chip. Under the current rules and geopolitical landscape, we are unable to create and deliver a competitive product for China’s data center market that receives approval from both the USG and the Chinese government. We have effectively been foreclosed from competing in China's data center computing/compute market, and our effective foreclosure from the China market will help our competitors build larger developer and customer ecosystems to challenge us worldwide. Unless we are able to return with a product that meets the approval of both the USG and the Chinese government, our lost opportunity and the benefit to our competitors will have a material and adverse impact on our business, operating results, and financial condition.

In 2023, we introduced our first data center CPU, Grace, built for giant-scale AI and high-performance computing, or HPC. records.query: 為什麼大家做 AI 都要靠 NVIDIA 的技術，別家學不來？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 之所以成為 AI 開發的核心，是因為它提供了從硬體到軟體完整的加速運算平台，讓 AI 工作負載在效能、成本與生態系上都無可取代【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21】。

- **硬體領先**：NVIDIA 的 GPU 具備「數萬個運算核心」的平行處理能力，專為深度學習的訓練與推論設計，能處理巨量資料並支援生成式與代理式 AI 應用【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21】。Blackwell 架構與即將推出的 Rubin 平台更結合 GPU、CPU、DPU、NVLink 交換器與高速網路，提供資料中心級的效能與效率，甚至在成本上比前代降低最高 10 倍【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。

- **完整軟體堆疊**：NVIDIA 以 CUDA 為基礎，建構了「數百個領域專屬的軟體庫、框架、演算法、SDK 與 API」，形成一套能加速 AI、資料分析、科學運算與 3D 圖形的全方位工具鏈【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #19】。此外，NVIDIA AI Enterprise、NVIDIA NIM、NeMo、AI Blueprints 等軟體套件，讓企業能快速部署生成式 AI 應用，降低開發門檻【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #36】。

- **生態系規模**：全球已有超過 **750 萬** 開發者使用 CUDA 及其他工具，NVIDIA 也與主要雲端服務供應商（CSP）、OEM、ODM、系統整合商等深度合作，確保其平台遍佈所有主要伺服器與超級電腦【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #36】。其技術支援了 **78%** 的 TOP500 超級電腦，且在 Green500 前十名中佔 9 台，顯示其在高效能運算領域的絕對領導地位【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #23】。

records.query: 微軟是怎麼把 AI 塞進 Office 那些軟體裡的？
records.answer:
微軟是透過在 Microsoft 365（包含 Office 套件）內嵌入「Microsoft 365 Copilot」等生成式 AI 功能，將 AI 與雲端服務結合，直接在各項 Office 應用程式中提供智慧助理、內容產生與自動化工具【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #58】。

- Microsoft 365 Copilot 讓 Office、Windows 以及 Enterprise Mobility + Security 共同構成一個 AI‑powered 的商務與生產力平台，並持續加入 AI‑enabled 的工具、功能與「agentic」情境，覆蓋通訊、協作、分析、安全與合規等多個領域【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #58】。  
- 2026 年第一季（截至 2026‑03‑31）Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端收入成長 19%，其中每位使用者的收入提升主要來自 Microsoft 365 E5 與 Microsoft 365 Copilot 的推廣【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #116】。  
- 同期 Microsoft 365 Commercial 的座位數增長 6%，主要由中小企業與前線工作者的需求帶動，顯示 AI 功能已在更廣泛的使用者群體中部署【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #116】。  
- 為支援 Copilot 座位與使用量的增長，微軟投入大量 AI 基礎建設、運算容量、AI 人才與資料資源，導致成本項目上升 12%（成本增加 6.8 億美元（$680 million））【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #116】。  
- 這些 AI 投資同時提升了毛利，毛利金額增加 44 億美元（$4.4 billion）（增幅 18%），毛利率亦因 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端的效率提升而略有上升【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #116】。  
- 在更長的九個月期間（截至 2026‑03‑31），毛利金額增長 128 億美元（$12.8 billion）（18%），主要驅動因素仍是 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端的成長與 AI 效能提升【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #122】。  

綜合以上，微軟透過 Microsoft 365 Copilot 以及相關的 AI 基礎建設，將生成式 AI 深度整合至 Office 產品，並以雲端服務、使用者收入與座位數的提升來驗證這些 AI 功能的實際應用與商業效益。

records.query: Meta 搞的那些 VR 眼鏡跟 AI，到底想往哪個方向發展？
records.answer:
Meta 正在把 VR 眼鏡與 AI 深度結合，打造以 AI 為核心的沉浸式元宇宙平台，並同步研發下一代 AI 模型與 AR/VR 硬體，以推動未來的計算平台與使用者體驗【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #111】。

- META 在 2025 年的 10‑K 中說明，AI 投資已滲透至內容排序、推薦引擎、廣告工具、生成式 AI 體驗以及未來的超智慧（superintelligence）研發，目標是讓 AI 能在個人層面上提供更大價值【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #112】。  
- 在 Reality Labs 產品線方面，META 持續推出 Meta Quest 系列 VR 裝置、Ray‑Ban Meta 與 Oakley Meta AI 眼鏡，2024 年展示了具備業界領先視野的 Orion 真實 AR 眼鏡原型，2025 年則推出結合顯示鏡片與 AI 功能的 Meta Ray‑Ban Display，並搭配可透過肌電訊號控制的 Meta Neural Band 手環【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #117】。  
- 技術層面上，META 強調因使用者基數與影片、VR 互動需求的成長，計算需求持續上升；同時投入大量資源建置自有資料中心與第三方基礎設施，並持續投資生成式 AI、前沿 AI 模型與開源 Llama 基礎模型，以提升內容推薦、廣告投放與新產品開發的效能【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #124】。  
- META 亦指出，Reality Labs 的元宇宙與 AR/VR 策略仍屬長期且具不確定性的投資，若市場接受度未如預期或硬體開發未達目標，可能對公司聲譽與財務產生負面影響【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #63】。  
- 依 Business Summary，META 的營運分為「Family of Apps」與「Reality Labs」兩大部門，Reality Labs 主要提供虛擬與擴增實境的硬體、軟體與內容，並以 Meta Quest、AI 眼鏡等產品為核心，支撐其向沉浸式平台轉型的長期願景【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1】。  

綜合以上，META 的發展方向是：**以 AI 強化內容與廣告體驗，同時透過 VR/AR 硬體（Meta Quest、AI 眼鏡、AR 眼鏡原型與顯示技術）建構沉浸式元宇宙生態系，並持續投入前沿 AI 研發與基礎設施，以支撐未來的計算平台**。

Our product development philosophy centers on continuous innovation in creating and improving products that are social by design, which means that our products are designed to place people and their social interactions at the core of the product experience. Our ability to provide and continue to innovate our products and services depends on the continued availability of components, power, and network capacity. We are also investing in protecting the security, privacy, and integrity of our platform by investing in both people and technology to strengthen our systems against abuse. records.query: 特斯拉的自動駕駛跟別家車廠比，厲害在哪裡？
records.answer:
特斯拉的自動駕駛優勢在於所有量產車輛皆以自動駕駛為設計基礎，並透過自家 AI、視覺神經網路與客製化推論晶片，以及 OTA 軟體更新，於 2025 年 6 月即已推出 Robotaxi 服務，展現出相較於多數傳統汽車製造商更早的商業化應用。  

- **全車設計為自動駕駛**：Tesla 表示「Every Tesla vehicle delivered today is designed for autonomy」​[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #39]。  
- **AI 與視覺技術差異化**：公司說明「We use AI to develop real‑world applications, such as autonomous driving solutions… We utilize vision‑based technologies, systems and software to train our artificial neural networks」​[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #38]，並認為「our capabilities and advancements in AI differentiate us from our competitors」​[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #39]。  
- **自家客製化推論晶片**：Tesla 透露其 AI 訓練與推論均由「our own in‑house, custom designed inference chips」加速​[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #38]。  
- **OTA 軟體持續升級**：自動駕駛功能「improve… through over‑the‑air software updates」​[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #39]，讓車輛功能可在交付後持續提升。  
- **Robotaxi 商業化先行**：公司於「June 2025, we launched our Robotaxi service」​[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #34]，顯示已將自動駕駛技術實際應用於乘客共享平台。  
- **相對競爭環境**：雖然「we face strong competition… many established and new automobile manufacturers… have entered… the market for self‑driving technology」​[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #100]，但 Tesla 強調其 AI 與硬體整合的獨特性，使其在自動駕駛領域具備與傳統車廠不同的技術基礎。  

綜合以上，Tesla 的自動駕駛優勢在於全車平台化的自動駕駛設計、以視覺為核心的自研神經網路、專屬推論晶片、持續的 OTA 更新，以及已於 2025 年推出的 Robotaxi 商業服務，這些因素共同構成其相較於大多數傳統汽車製造商的差異化競爭力。

We believe that our vehicles compete in the market based on both their traditional segment classification as well as their propulsion technology. For example, Cybertruck competes with other pickup trucks, Model S and Model X compete primarily with premium sedans and premium SUVs and Model 3 and Model Y compete with small to medium-sized sedans and compact SUVs, all of which are extremely competitive markets. Competing products typically include internal combustion vehicles from more established automobile manufacturers; however, many established and new automobile manufacturers have entered or have announced plans to enter the market for electric and other alternative fuel vehicles. Overall, we believe these announcements and vehicle introductions promote the development of the electric vehicle market by highlighting the attractiveness of electric vehicles relative to internal combustion vehicles. [TSLA 10-K period 2025] [section: Vehicle Safety and Testing] Some of those regulations impact or prevent the rollout of new vehicle features. 8


Regulation of Autonomous Vehicles and Autonomous Vehicle Ride-Hailing 

Generally, laws pertaining to autonomous vehicles are evolving globally, and in some cases may impose restrictions on our features or vehicle designs. In the U.S., while NHTSA has updated certain FMVSS to account for autonomous vehicle design, other FMVSS and regulations do not currently account for autonomous vehicle design and additional rulemaking by NHTSA may occur. These requirements are in addition to manufacturer reporting obligations, and NHTSA retains the authority to investigate and/or take action on the safety or compliance of any vehicle, equipment or features operating on public roads. Additionally, certain U.S. states and cities have legal restrictions on, or are considering additional regulation of, the testing, commercial operation, marketing, registration and licensure of autonomous vehicles, including commercial ride-hailing with a fleet of autonomous vehicles, and many other states and cities are considering them. This regulatory patchwork increases the legal complexity with respect to autonomous vehicles and an autonomous vehicle ride-hailing business in the U.S. In Europe and other countries that follow the regulations of the United Nations Economic Commission for Europe (“ECE countries”), some requirements restrict the design of both advanced driver-assistance and autonomous systems, which can compromise or prevent their use entirely. On a European Union level, additional layers of regulatory frameworks may impose further obligations in areas such as risk management, data-governance, trainings, technical documentation. Meanwhile, on a national level, the enforcement of certain applicable regulations may vary. Proposed national laws may further hinder or complicate the path of both advanced driver-assistance and autonomous vehicle systems, including the timeline for introducing autonomous vehicles for sale and use in ECE countries. Additionally, certain national and city laws within each ECE country may impose legal restrictions on the marketing of advanced driver-assistance and autonomous vehicle systems, and may vary significantly on commercial ride-hailing with a fleet of autonomous vehicles, in areas such as licenses, permits, competition prohibitions, tariffs and other transport services obligations. When coupled together, the layers of regulation as well as the fragmentation across each ECE country may hinder or complicate the path and timeline to introducing autonomous vehicles and an autonomous vehicle ride-hailing business in them. Other key markets, including China, continue to develop and establish driver-assistance and autonomous vehicle regulations. Any implemented regulations may differ materially from U.S.

foreign regulatory agencies prior to market entry, as well as compliance with foreign reporting and recall management systems requirements. records.query: 微軟的雲端服務最近成長得快不快？
records.answer:
微軟的雲端服務成長非常快速，Azure 及其他雲端服務的營收在最近一年均以約 **40%** 的年增率上升，整體雲端部門營收也同步提升約 **29%‑30%**【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #97】【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #123】【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #117】。

- **Q3 FY2026 vs Q3 FY2025**：Microsoft Cloud 營收增長 **29%**，達 **545 億美元（$54.5 billion）**，其中 Azure 與其他雲端服務營收 **增長 40%**【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #97】。  
- **九個月截至 2026/03/31 vs 2025/03/31**：Intelligent Cloud 營收增加 **221 億美元（$22.1 billion）**，即 **29%**，而 Azure 與其他雲端服務營收同樣 **增長 40%**【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #123】。  
- **三個月截至 2026/03/31 vs 2025/03/31**：Intelligent Cloud 營收增加 **79 億美元（$7.9 billion）**，即 **30%**，Azure 與其他雲端服務營收亦 **增長 40%**【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #117】。  
- **Microsoft 365 商業雲端**：在同一期間（九個月）其雲端營收 **增長 18%**，在最近一季則 **增長 19%**，顯示雲端訂閱與每位使用者收入皆持續提升【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #97】。  

綜合以上，無論是整體雲端部門還是核心 Azure 平台，微軟的雲端服務均展現出兩位數的高速成長。

The rally followed IREN’s disclosure of a five-gigawatt strategic partnership with Nvidia tied to the deployment of AI infrastructure across its global data center pipeline. Under the agreement, IREN issued Nvidia a five-year right to purchase up to 30 million ordinary shares at $70 per share. If fully exercised, the right would represent up to $2.1 billion of potential investment, subject to conditions including regulatory limits. IREN also announced a separate five-year, $3.4 billion AI Cloud contract with Nvidia for air-cooled Blackwell GPUs, with deployment expected within 60 megawatts of existing data centers at Childress and a targeted ramp beginning in early 2027. The update pushes IREN further away from the pure bitcoin-mining identity it carried when it operated as Iris Energy.
